text:
Dina Gomez: Quick kickoff  MeridianCloud asked us to support a pilot in their APAC mini-region (southeast edge PoP). Request: 4x A40-eq nodes, SI partner will run an on-site appliance for network termination, KMS trust model (bring-your-own-key), marketplace entitlement, and a joint launch brief. Proposed soft launch: 2025-03-10. Who picks up quotas, SI coordination, legal/commercial?

Amit Rao: I can own quota + infra. Need exact SKU IDs and a brief on expected qps and average token lengths. Also need the SI contact for appliance install and a runbook for peering.

Marco (MeridianCloud): Hi all  baseline 12k requests/day, spikes to 60k/day. Avg 220 tokens/request, occasional 1.2k token flows. SKUs recommended: a40-48g-standard (x4) + 2x burst nodes. SI partner is "EdgeSys" and they will handle the colo handoff; contact is jen@edgesys.example.com.

Leah Kim: Marketplace lead  Ill draft the tile and entitlement flow. Need logo SVG, 200-word blurb, and whether we require a paid listing (partner wants reserved pricing). Also need to know if we expose "Dedicated" SKU on the marketplace or keep it partner-only.

Marco (MeridianCloud): We want the Dedicated listing visible in the partner catalog but gated via entitlement code for the pilot. We'll provide branding and a short co-marketing blurb. We also need a purchase order to enable reserved pricing.

security-bot: Security checklist triggered: cross-account CMK verification, network ACL review, and SI appliance firmware attestation. Add items to onboarding checklist: KMS ARN, grant policy, VPC peering CIDR, and appliance serial + firmware hash.

Amit Rao: Filing quota request now. Ticket: CREQ-MC-4120  asking for 4 reserved a40-48g + 2 burst nodes, start 2025-01-20, duration 4 months. Link: https://cloud.example/CREQ-MC-4120

procure-ops: To enable reserved pricing we need a signed PO / commercial reference. Please route MeridianCloud through contract ops and include the PO number on provisioning ticket.

Dina Gomez: Commercial note  Meridian signed an MOU for the pilot. Legal asked for a short DPA addendum covering cross-account KMS and SI-managed appliance telemetry. Legal contact: legal+partners@redwood.example.com.

Leah Kim: Draft marketplace copy (v0): "MeridianCloud + Redwood pilot: APAC edge serving with Dedicated GPUs and enterprise peering. Pilot availability via entitlement code; enterprise onboarding supported." Thoughts?

Marco (MeridianCloud): Looks good. Add: "Supports SI-managed network termination (EdgeSys) and customer-managed keys."

Amit Rao: infra note: SI appliance will terminate peer and NAT to our private subnet. Need the EdgeSys runbook and onsite IP allocation before we schedule BGP session. Jenna from EdgeSys already sent a preliminary wiring diagram.

security-bot: Reminder: we need firmware attestation files from EdgeSys and control-plane access window for hardening verification. Also collect syslog forwarding endpoint and retention policy.

procure-ops: MeridianCloud sent a preliminary PO ID: PO-MC-7788. Please attach the signed PO to CREQ-MC-4120 to enable reserved pricing.

Dina Gomez: Action items recap: Amit -> CREQ-MC-4120 + provision plan; Leah -> marketplace tile + entitlement flow; Legal -> DPA addendum + PR guardrails; Security -> KMS acceptance + appliance attestation; Procure -> confirm PO. Internal review cutoff: 2025-02-05.

Amit Rao: Added CREQ link and PO comment: https://cloud.example/CREQ-MC-4120 (PO-MC-7788). Est approval: 6-9 business days.

Marco (MeridianCloud): EdgeSys will upload firmware attestation and wiring docs by 2024-12-28. Branding assets will be uploaded to the partner bucket by 2025-01-02.

Leah Kim: Will prepare an entitlement code flow and draft listing; will post draft here once assets arrive. If quotas are delayed, fallback: run pilot on Hosted with smaller nodes and keep enterprise listing gated. Ill own the fallback messaging.

Dina Gomez: Great. Please update thread with approvals, PO attachment, and CREQ status. Next sync Monday 15:00 UTC. :calendar:

Amit Rao: Noted. Opening contact with EdgeSys now.

Marco (MeridianCloud): Thanks everyone, well keep you posted from Meridian side.
